opening.argument: The video presents social media as a tool for personal growth, asking viewers, “How many times you will waste time on your social media?” and stating that it should be used “for your growth.” Although the title references a “Life Change Opportunity,” an “Online Earning Platform,” and investment-related themes, the available material does not specify earnings, require payment, request sensitive information, or provide concrete money-transfer instructions. A frame directs viewers to “DM me” followed by a phone number, making the presentation promotional, but that contact prompt alone does not establish a deceptive solicitation or a particular financial outcome.
